name: All SaaS/Software MUST be registered in the CMDB to ensure a complete and auditable inventory of digital assets.
conditionsText: When a product or team purchase a SaaS product
requirementTitle: All SaaS/Software MUST be registered in the CMDB to ensure a complete and auditable inventory of digital assets.
requirementDescription: Every software application or SaaS service used by the organisation must be formally recorded in the CMDB (Configuration Management Database) so there is a complete record of what software exists
why: We cannot secure what we do not know exists. SaaS is easy to lose track of because it can be bought and used without infrastructure being deployed internally
tasks: All SaaS/Software MUST be registered in the CMDB to ensure a complete and auditable inventory of digital assets.

actions.title: All SaaS/Software MUST be registered in the CMDB to ensure a complete and auditable inventory of digital assets.
actions.description: If a team procures a SaaS product they should use the create a service offering form in Service Now to register the product in the CMDB
